items.title: 93% of AI Search Sessions End Without Website Visits: GEO and AEO Take Over
items.summary: Traditional SEO is declared dead as 93% of AI search sessions conclude without users clicking to websites. The post emphasizes the urgent shift to Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) for visibility in 2026. Marketers are urged to adapt their strategies amid recent changes.

items.title: Listicle Articles: Easiest Hack for Local Businesses in ChatGPT and AI Overviews
items.summary: Publishing listicles is highlighted as the simplest tactic to secure citations and recommendations for local businesses in AI tools like ChatGPT and Google AI Overviews. The strategy has been tested with hundreds of articles for client success. This approach boosts AEO in evolving search landscapes.

items.title: Claude AI Now Performs SEO Like a $10K/Month Agency—for Free
items.summary: An update to Claude enables it to handle complex SEO tasks comparable to expensive agencies at no cost. This breakthrough democratizes advanced SEO for businesses and individuals. It's positioned as a major tool in the AI-driven SEO evolution.

items.title: Generative Engine Optimization: Semrush's Practical Guide to AI Search Visibility
items.summary: Semrush releases a detailed guide on GEO, essential for brands to gain prominence in AI-generated responses amid shifting search paradigms. The resource outlines actionable strategies to compete in the AI search era. Traditional SEO must now integrate GEO for sustained success.<grok:render type="render_inline_citation"><argument name="citation_id">2</argument></grok:render>

items.title: SEO Experiment Proves Misinformation Ranks Easily on Google Post-Core Update
items.summary: A recent SEO test reveals how straightforward it is to manipulate Google rankings with false information, even after the March 2026 core update. This underscores persistent vulnerabilities in search quality. SEOs are advised to double down on authoritative, high-quality content.<grok:render type="render_inline_citation"><argument name="citation_id">12</argument></grok:render>

items.title: Google's AI Mode Overhauls SEO: 5 Essential New Rules for Marketers
items.summary: Google's AI Mode has fundamentally altered SEO, invalidating old playbooks according to a 25-year veteran. The video breaks down five critical new rules to succeed in this landscape. Marketers ignoring these changes risk obsolescence.<grok:render type="render_inline_citation"><argument name="citation_id">1</argument></grok:render>

items.title: Axed AI copyright exception welcomed by book trade but damaging avenues remain
items.summary: UK book trade bodies welcome government's decision allowing rights holders to opt out of AI data usage for training. They warn other paths remain open for AI firms to access works without consent. This addresses ongoing AI copyright debates in publishing.

items.title: AI Generated Books Are Hurting Authors
items.summary: AI-generated books are flooding Amazon, often copying or summarizing existing works without permission. This low-quality content harms sales and visibility for human authors. Detection challenges exacerbate the issue in the publishing market.

items.title: Don't Steal This Book: 10,000 authors publish empty protest book against AI theft
items.summary: Nearly 10,000 authors published 'Don't Steal This Book', a mostly empty book protesting AI companies' use of their works for training data without permission. It urges the UK government against upending copyright law. Free copies available at London Book Fair.

items.title: Penguin Random House seeks marginalized voices, excludes straight white men in submissions
items.summary: Penguin Random House's call for submissions prioritizes 'marginalized voices' while explicitly excluding straight white men. The post highlights viral backlash over perceived discrimination in publishing. Internet users criticize the policy.

items.title: Publishing captured by woke ideology; seek indie and old books
items.summary: Big 5 publishers influenced by woke ideology would reject classics like Tolkien or Hemingway today. Recommendation to read older books and support indie authors to escape censorship. Highlights shift in traditional storytelling acceptance.

items.title: Oscars 2026 Ratings Slump Attributed to Woke Virtue Signalling
items.summary: The 2026 Oscars experienced a 9% drop in viewership compared to the previous year, hitting the lowest figures since 2022. The post highlights viewers tuning out due to Hollywood celebrities' virtue signalling and woke activism. Variety is cited as the source for the ratings data.

items.title: Oscars Viewership in Steep Decline Over Woke Hollywood Lectures
items.summary: Oscars ratings have fallen from 45 million in 1996 to 17 million in 2026. The post claims audiences are tired of hypocritical lectures from woke Hollywood elites. This trend shows a consistent drop over two decades.

items.title: Rachel Zegler Doubles Down on Snow White Casting Controversy
items.summary: Rachel Zegler addresses backlash to her casting in Disney's Snow White remake, stating she refuses to assimilate for others' comfort. The response comes after the film's box office flop and criticism of her production comments. Featured in Harper’s Bazaar UK interview.

items.title: Disney Star Rachel Zegler Refuses to 'Assimilate' Amid Snow White Backlash
items.summary: Rachel Zegler responds to critics upset over her casting as Snow White in Disney's live-action remake. She declares she will not assimilate for anybody else's comfort. The controversy involves her previous comments on the original story.

items.title: Woke Films Keep Flopping and Hollywood Is Finally Listening
items.summary: Multiple woke films have bombed at the box office, while family-friendly content sees success. Hollywood is shifting amid parent-led demand for non-preachy entertainment. March 2026 marks a recovery with strong performances from non-woke releases.

items.title: Google Launches Free AI Marketing Suite for Small Businesses
items.summary: Google has introduced a powerful free AI tool that scans a small business's website, analyzes its brand, and automatically generates customized ads, social media posts, headlines, CTAs, and even animated video creatives. This brand-matched content is available in over 170 countries, empowering solopreneurs and small teams with professional marketing without the high costs. It's hailed as one of Google's most impactful free AI business tools to date.

items.title: 10 Ways Small Businesses Are Leading AI Adoption Over Big Corporations
items.summary: Small businesses are leveraging AI for 24/7 phone support with tools like Rosie, cash flow forecasting with 30-50% improved accuracy, unbiased hiring, hyper-personalized marketing, and automated operations, often faster than large firms bogged down by bureaucracy. 91% report direct revenue increases, 68% use AI daily, and many have expanded hiring as a result. This shift arms SMBs against giants, turning speed and agility into competitive edges.

items.title: 24 Essential AI Tools Driving Growth for Small Businesses
items.summary: HubSpot's guide highlights practical AI tools for small businesses across sales (e.g., HubSpot Breeze CRM, Madgicx ads), marketing, operations, and e-commerce (Helium 10), focusing on automation that delivers real results like revenue boosts and efficiency gains. These vetted solutions help SMBs scale without large teams, emphasizing tools that 'actually work' for everyday challenges. Updated in March 2026 with the latest effective options.

items.title: Anthropic Expands Claude AI Presence with New Sydney Office in Australia
items.summary: AI leader Anthropic, maker of the Claude model, is launching a Sydney office to tap into the growing Australia and New Zealand markets, enhancing access to advanced AI tools for businesses. This strategic platform move supports regional expansion amid surging demand for reliable enterprise AI solutions. Announced March 10, 2026, it signals meaningful investment in global business AI infrastructure.
